sql: SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.Quantity) AS total_qty FROM orders o JOIN order_items od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE o.OrderDate BETWEEN '1997-06-01' AND '1997-06-30' GROUP BY c.CategoryName ORDER BY total_qty DESC LIMIT 1;
explanation: Summer Beverages 1997 promotion period; Beverages dominated sales.

sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID), 2) AS aov FROM orders o JOIN order_items od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID WHERE o.OrderDate BETWEEN '1997-12-01' AND '1997-12-31';
explanation: AOV calculated using the exact KPI definition over Winter Classics period.

sql: SELECT p.ProductName, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items od JOIN products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3;
explanation: Pure SQL query on revenue definition.

sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID JOIN categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID WHERE c.CategoryName = 'Beverages' AND o.OrderDate BETWEEN '1997-06-01' AND '1997-06-30';
explanation: Revenue from Beverages category during the defined summer promotion dates.

sql: SELECT c.CompanyName AS customer, ROUND(SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount) * 0.3), 2) AS margin FROM orders o JOIN order_items od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN customers c ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '1997' GROUP BY c.CustomerID ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 1;
explanation: Gross margin approximated as 30% of revenue (CostOfGoods ≈ 0.7 × UnitPrice) for 1997 data.
